method: identical comparative values (NetIncomeLoss/Assets/StockholdersEquity frames, >=2 matches across >=2 concepts, |diff|<=0.1%) between a late-starting CIK and an earlier filer
use: PIT engine enriches successor state with predecessor facts filed before successor's first periodic filing; successor rows start at its own first filing.
co_registrant: True = parallel co-filer (first filings <90 days apart), ignored by the PIT engine; only the primary predecessor per successor (most matches, then earliest filer) is chained
